AllowedUnreached.description: An explicit readiness exception; it never claims convergence.

baseline_observed.description: Baseline observation, retained even when null.

CompareMode.description: Field selection for arm validity checks.

oneOf.description: Compare every effective metadata field (the compatibility default).
Compare only mapped destinations, readiness and declared derived fields.

ComparisonResult.description: Identity validity, independent of any pixel verdict.

oneOf.description: Complete identities differ only in declared variables or explicit ignores.
Missing or mismatched identity prevents a measurement verdict.

Finding.description: A recorded field finding; explicit states distinguish null from absence.

baseline_state.description: Baseline state: missing, absent (when explicitly a value), null or value.

capture_state.description: Candidate state: missing, absent (when explicitly a value), null or value.

reason.description: Stable reason: missing, difference, readiness_not_reached, malformed.

token_matches.description: Tokens covering this finding, with the exact destination or source name matched.

KeySummary.description: Bounded, sorted union of excluded effective keys from both arms.

count.description: Total distinct keys, including keys omitted from the list.

truncated.description: Whether the key list omits any keys.

MatchedName.description: Origin of a name matched by an explicit token.

oneOf.description: Producer source path from the fingerprint map.

TokenMatch.description: One explicit token match; both names are reported when both match.

name.description: Exact name tested against the token, without a directory image prefix.

via.description: Whether the matched name is a canonical destination or producer source.

description: Validity only; this result never contains a pixel pass/fail verdict.

absent_fields.description: Mapped fields explicitly treating absence as a value, including equal absences.

allowed_unreached.description: Explicitly permitted matched unreached predicates with both observations.

compare.description: Effective map comparison mode, including any CLI override.

covered_by_derivation.description: Differences covered by explicit field derivations, with both values.

covered_by_vary.description: Differences covered by vary tokens, with matched names and both values.

diagnostics.description: Record discovery diagnostics, including exact searched filenames.

ignore.description: Explicit ignored tokens, including tokens matching no fields.

ignored.description: Explicitly waived findings, including missing fields and equal nulls.

outcomes.description: Fields explicitly excluded by the map's outcome globs in either mode.

unmapped.description: Unmapped fields; excluded in mapped_only and compared in all mode.
